entity.Faction.AstralSharks.description: Legends of the cosmic deep, Astral Sharks glide through space with celestial fins and stardust-infused teeth. They're the titans of the galactic oceans.
entity.Faction.AstralSharks.title: Astral Sharks
entity.Faction.Astrogoblins.description: Mischievous beings that can be found in every corner of the galaxy, Astrogoblins zip around in makeshift spacecrafts, armed with primitive weapons and a liking for interstellar chaos.
entity.Faction.Astrogoblins.title: Astrogoblins
entity.Faction.Boss.description: An immense, dark mass of writhing tentacles, teeth and a thousand eyes. The vacuum of space around the station suppresses all noise, but you can feel the hatred of the alien beast and see its determination to destroy everything you have built up.
entity.Faction.Boss.title: Boss
entity.Faction.CometCrawlers.description: These beagle-sized beetles travel on the surface of comets as they are attracted by metal alloys that are unfortunately also commonly found in space stations. They will attack in large numbers if they sense one of their own being harmed.
entity.Faction.CometCrawlers.title: Comet Crawlers
entity.Faction.MeteorMaws.description: Gigantic, worm-like beings that burrow through meteors and small moons, leaving characteristic holes. They are attracted to the vibrations of engines and can engulf smaller vessels whole.
entity.Faction.MeteorMaws.title: Meteor Maws
entity.Faction.NovaFlies.description: Similar to earth's long lost fireflies, these bugs are glowing on their own. Experiencing their gigantic numbers and blinding brightness quickly explains the name.
entity.Faction.NovaFlies.title: Nova Flies
entity.Faction.Scavengers.description: Outcasts from civilizations across the galaxy, Scavengers form nomadic crews, dressed in distinctive leather attire. Masters of illicit trade and makeshift tech, they roam, seeking quick profits through heists and elusive alliances.
entity.Faction.Scavengers.title: Scavengers
entity.Faction.SpacePirates.description: Buccaneers sailing the astral seas, Space Pirates are notorious for their flashy ships, over-the-top personalities, and the relentless pursuit of rare space booty.
entity.Faction.SpacePirates.title: Space Pirates
entity.Faction.StarMantas.description: Majestic creatures that glide through the vacuum of space, their vast wingspans absorb cosmic radiation. Often mistaken for celestial phenomena, they can be fiercely territorial.
entity.Faction.StarMantas.title: Star Mantas
entity.Faction.ThunderDragon.description: Roaming the storm nebula, Thunder Dragons are colossal beings of electric energy. Lightning crackles across their scales as they soar through the interstellar space.
entity.Faction.ThunderDragon.title: Thunder Dragon
entity.Faction.VoidVikings.description: Clad in dark matter armor, Void Vikings raid across the galaxy in search of glory and cosmic runes. Their battle cries resonate through the vacuum, freezing the hearts of their foes.
entity.Faction.VoidVikings.title: Void Vikings
entity.GridStrength.gridStrength.title: Grid Strength
entity.Module.BiotechDome.description: A controlled ecosystem where life is cultivated and knowledge grows.
entity.Module.BiotechDome.title: Biotech Dome
entity.Module.CommandCenter.description: A place where impactful decisions are made, destinies shaped and large amounts of vaporized caffeine consumed.
entity.Module.CommandCenter.title: Command Center
entity.Module.Defensive.description: The station's sword and shield. Whether repelling invaders or standing guard, peace is made by those prepared for war.
entity.Module.Defensive.title: Defensive Module
entity.Module.Furnace.description: The beating heart of industry, transforming raw into refined and ordinary into extraordinary. The forge of future tech.
entity.Module.Furnace.title: Furnace Module
entity.Module.MiningBay.description: For some, space is vast and empty. For others, its the greatest treasure trove there is.
entity.Module.MiningBay.title: Mining Bay
entity.Module.Quarters.description: A home among the stars. From the hum of daily life to the legends of immortal warriors, every soul contributes to the journey.
entity.Module.Quarters.title: Quarters Module
entity.Module.RescueCapsule.description: A tiny escape pod, just big enough to house a single person, allowing you to flee the station as a last resort.
entity.Module.RescueCapsule.title: Rescue Capsule
entity.ModuleCategory.StationCore.title: Station Core
entity.ModuleComponent.Agriculture.descr: Farming is honest work. Even more so in space.
entity.ModuleComponent.Agriculture.title: Agriculture
entity.ModuleComponent.CaptainsFocus.des: We are in far far future, but you still only have two hands.
entity.ModuleComponent.CrewExpansion.des: If you're not growing, you are dying.
entity.ModuleComponent.Doctrine.descript: Educate your crew, form their ethos and shape their spirit to prepare them for the battlefield.
entity.ModuleComponent.Doctrine.title: Doctrine
entity.ModuleComponent.Drill.description: It's big. It spins. It can be used against enemies in a pinch.
entity.ModuleComponent.Drill.title: Drill
entity.ModuleComponent.Fuel.description: The lifeblood of the station allows all systems to run, machinery to hum and keeps the lights on.
entity.ModuleComponent.Fuel.title: Fuel
entity.ModuleComponent.JumpStarter.descr: It zaps stuff back to life!
entity.ModuleComponent.JumpStarter.title: Jump Starter
entity.ModuleComponent.MinedResource.des: The foundation for station expansion. From common rocks to exotic minerals, each resource fuels progress and prosperity.
entity.ModuleComponent.Products.descript: Transmuting raw resources into vital materials. Whether it's for construction or commerce, the furnace forges the foundation of expansion.
entity.ModuleComponent.Products.title: Products
entity.ModuleComponent.Protection.descri: The defense against all the dangers out there. Become a fortress among the stars!
entity.ModuleComponent.Protection.title: Protection
entity.ModuleComponent.TheLab.descriptio: Entry forbidden for people under 120 IQ. Sorry Sir, no exceptions.
entity.ModuleComponent.TheLab.title: The Lab
entity.ModuleComponent.Turrets.descripti: Turrets deliver superior firepower, allowing you to go on the offensive to destroy all foes and repel aggressive invaders.
entity.ModuleComponent.Turrets.title: Turrets
entity.ModuleOperation.AlgaePod.descript: Feed your crew with lab grown algae, keeping them alive but not necessarily happy.
entity.ModuleOperation.AlgaePod.title: Algae Pod
entity.ModuleOperation.AntiMaterialSwarm: A cloud of alien defenders swarming around the station, tearing through incoming missiles and ripping hulls to shreds.
entity.ModuleOperation.ArtificialEcosyst: Don't wait for evolution, make it happen!.
entity.ModuleOperation.AsteroidChomper.d: A significant upgrade in mining tech, this beast chews through smaller asteroids with ease, turning rocks into progress and enemies into tomato mist.
entity.ModuleOperation.BigSpinny.descrip: Simple yet effective. Once it starts spinning space rocks and enemies alike fear for their well-being.
entity.ModuleOperation.BigSpinny.title: The Big Spinny
entity.ModuleOperation.BossFertilizer.de: Let's face it, it's alien poop.
entity.ModuleOperation.Bouncium.descript: Want a metal that possesses the properties of highly flexible rubber? Bouncium is where it's at.
entity.ModuleOperation.Bouncium.title: Bouncium
entity.ModuleOperation.BulletSponge.desc: Alien tissue named appropriately for it's ability to absorb even the toughest hits
entity.ModuleOperation.Diesel.descriptio: An ancient fuel, so you can feel like an honest space trucker.
entity.ModuleOperation.Diesel.title: Diesel
Observing fermentation leads to grand discoveries. And much more importantly: fizzy drinks.
entity.ModuleOperation.FourDPrinter.desc: Prints anything from spare parts to midnight snacks. Adds a dimension of convenience to survival.
entity.ModuleOperation.Garbage.descripti: Just garbage, crawling with vent rats and station roaches. It's neither efficient nor sustainable, but it smells even worse.
entity.ModuleOperation.Garbage.title: Garbage
entity.ModuleOperation.GlitzPlating.desc: Tougher than a Comet Crawler's shell, this armor resists most of galaxy's temper.
entity.ModuleOperation.GloryToTheGreatHe: Heroes inspire, their legends propel us forward. This principle celebrates extraordinary feats, encouraging all to reach beyond the stars.
entity.ModuleOperation.Greenhouse.descri: Simulating good old Terra, a place for plants and crops to thrive.
entity.ModuleOperation.Greenhouse.title: Greenhouse
entity.ModuleOperation.HeavyGlitz.descri: It's shiny, it conducts sparks, it's surprisingly heavy and hard.
entity.ModuleOperation.HeavyGlitz.title: Heavy Glitz
entity.ModuleOperation.KungFuManual.desc: The weapon of choice for the true captain. When you wield it, the station's armaments move as if mirroring your every action.
entity.ModuleOperation.LaserTurrets.desc: Highly precise and devastatingly destructive. Even space ants fear the final form of the magnifying glass.
entity.ModuleOperation.MechanoMaker.desc: Why wait for nature, when you can assemble new, mechanical crewmates all by yourself.
entity.ModuleOperation.MicroCyborgAutoma: A handy box that produces little helpers at the press of a button.
entity.ModuleOperation.MicroalloyGlass.d: One thousand times as hard as steel, but so clear that you could call it invisible.
entity.ModuleOperation.NanoHardener.desc: Active Nano Robots that make the armor layer one of the hardest materials in the galaxy.
Bend life to your will and discover what lies behind the curtain.
entity.ModuleOperation.Plastics.descript: Plastics can be anything and are everywhere, even inside your body.
entity.ModuleOperation.Plastics.title: Plastics
Studying is for dweebs, but shiny new tech is cool.
entity.ModuleOperation.PulseShield.descr: A shimmering barrier that guards against incoming threats and sends projectiles back from where they came.
entity.ModuleOperation.PulseShield.title: Pulse Shield
entity.ModuleOperation.Quasarite.descrip: Remnants of a distant quasar explosion. Otherworldly amounts of energy, please handle with care.
entity.ModuleOperation.Quasarite.title: Quasarite
entity.ModuleOperation.Radiance.descript: Tingles in your hand but glows in the dark. Even heavier than the regular glitz.
entity.ModuleOperation.Radiance.title: Radiance
These turrets will quickly fill the vacuum of space with lead and your enemies with holes.
entity.ModuleOperation.Recruitment.descr: Broadcast a message across the stars and recruit willing and capable crewmates.
entity.ModuleOperation.Recruitment.title: Recruitment
entity.ModuleOperation.ReplicationChambe: Cloning crewmates is pretty easy. You found the secret to having them survive for more than an hour.
entity.ModuleOperation.SmellyJelly.descr: People often argue about the scent of this highly concentrated jet fuel. Its potent aroma is adored by some, stomach-churning for most.
entity.ModuleOperation.SmellyJelly.title: Smelly Jelly
entity.ModuleOperation.SpaceRocks.descri: Space seems to be filled with either nothingness or those rocks.
entity.ModuleOperation.SpaceRocks.title: Space Rocks
The ole reliable of power sources. It may grumble and spew smoke, but it'll keep the lights on when all else fails.
entity.ModuleOperation.Steel.description: Whether you need to outfit your troops with armor or want to build new living quarters, you can rely on steel.
entity.ModuleOperation.Steel.title: Steel
entity.ModuleOperation.Survivors.descrip: Space is vast, but you’re not leaving anyone behind. Rescue survivors to add their skills and stories to your crew.
entity.ModuleOperation.Survivors.title: Pick up survivors
entity.ModuleOperation.TenDrills.descrip: Mechanical or organic? Are those 10 drills or actually tentacles?!
entity.ModuleOperation.TenDrills.title: TenDrills
Strength in unity, victory through collaboration. This doctrine binds the crew as one, turning collective will into unstoppable force.
entity.ModuleOperation.UnitedbyPurpose.d: Organics and Mechanics can agree: When the stations dies, everyone dies.
entity.PointOfInterest.GrowthLocationExt: The edge of known space. Navigation is tricky, and reality behaves oddly here.
entity.PointOfInterest.GrowthLocationHig: A rare paradise with vital resources. Also a popular hangout for not-so-friendly giant space beasts.
entity.PointOfInterest.GrowthLocationLow: A cloud of space gas that literally bubbles. Perfect for cool selfies and fizzy drinks.
entity.PointOfInterest.GrowthLocationMed: Fields of glowing, crystal flora. Harvestable as a powerful snack, but they're a bit... temperamental.
entity.PointOfInterest.IndustryLocationE: A graveyard of ancient spacecrafts, rumored to be haunted. Treasure trove of tech and secrets, but eerily guarded.
entity.PointOfInterest.IndustryLocationH: A market run by actual shadows. Trade at your own risk, they're known for tricky deals.
entity.PointOfInterest.IndustryLocationM: A star about to go boom, but it's taking its sweet time. Stellar resources available, with a risk.
entity.PointOfInterest.ResearchLocationE: It doesn't just destroy; it serenades you into oblivion. Unique insights if you dare to listen.
entity.PointOfInterest.ResearchLocationH: Emits deadly sound waves. Great for advanced tech parts if you can withstand the noise.
entity.PointOfInterest.ResearchLocationL: A collection of mini wormholes that show reflections of alternate realities.
entity.PointOfInterest.ResearchLocationM: Twin moons that supposedly whisper space secrets. Good for intel, if you can decipher the murmurs.
entity.PointOfInterest.SafeZone.descript: Long-abandoned extraction facilities orbiting in a stable sector. Safe from hostile activity, they continue to yield basic resources through dormant automated systems.
entity.PointOfInterest.SafeZone.title: Ex-Nova Mines
A cosmic ballet of stars creates a breathtaking celestial display. The radiant starlight powers the station. Additionally, this point of interest is known for advanced stargazing technology, attracting astronomers and enthusiasts from across the galaxy.
